content_sections.text: Apply online at https://www.ucms.ac.in/administration/showcareers. Forward hard copy through proper channel to Principal, UCMS, Dilshad Garden, Delhi-110095. Apply on or before 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UCMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UCMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 21 vacancies: 1 Internal Audit Officer, 1 Assistant Registrar, 3 Section Officer, 2 Professional Assistant, 5 Senior Assistant, 9 Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UCMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on closing date of advertisement).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Pay Level 12 for Internal Audit Officer, Pay Level 10 for Assistant Registrar, Pay Level 7 for Section Officer, Pay Level 6 for Professional Assistant, Pay Level 6 for Senior Assistant.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be serving on regular basis in Central/State Govt, Universities, PSUs, Autonomous Organizations. Applications through proper channel only.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview/Interaction. Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation initially for 1 year (extendable up to 5 years) or till post filled on regular basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Delhi.
